name: const unsafe fn byte_offset_from < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : * const U) -> isize
rule: For safety, the absolute distance in bytes between the data pointers of `self` and `origin`, computed on mathematical integers without wrapping, must not exceed `isize::MAX`.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * const T { const unsafe fn byte_offset_from < U : ? Sized > (self , origin : * const U) -> isize }
